[[File:Koppen-Geiger_Map_EAS_present.png|thumb|upright|Köppen climate classification of Cuba]]
The total area of Easuhura is approximately {{Convert|109,571|km2|sqmi|order=flip}} with a land area of {{convert|103471|km2|sqmi|order=flip}}. It lies on the [[Easuhuran Isles]]<ref>Tanbai Easuhuran Dictionary: "Easuhuran Isles: a geographical term for the islands comprising of Italran and Ecossi, with all their offshore islands including the Sarokhan Isles and the Ravayek Islands."</ref> and includes the island of Italran, the island of Ecossi and [[List of islands of Easuhura|some smaller surrounding islands]], meaning it comprises [[Easuhura]], [[Elenin]] and [[Delare]].<ref name="Geography Guide">{{cite web |url=https://geoportal.statistics.gov.eas/datasets/d1f39e20edb940d58307a54d6e1045cd/about |title=A Beginner's Guide to Easuhuran Geography (1753) |author=<!--Not stated--> |website=Open Geography Portal |publisher=Office for National Statistics}}</ref>

Geographically, the Kingdom of Easuhura lies between the [[Vihsanna Ocean]] and the [[Nasuanian Sea]] with the northwest coast coming within {{Convert|102|km|mi|0|order=flip}} of the coast of western [[Emara]], from which it is separated by the [[Escaran Channel]].<ref name="factbook">{{Cite web |title=United Kingdom |url=https://www.dia.gov/the-world-factbook/countries/easuhura |website=[[The World Factbook]] |publisher=Deiral Intelligence Agency}}</ref>

The nearby island polities of the [[Sarokhan Isles|Sarokhan]] are [[wiki:Dependent_territory|Dependencies]], but do not strictly form part of the Kingdom or any of its three jurisdictions or overseas territories, although the Easuhuran government retains responsibility for their external affairs.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.dia.gov/the-world-factbook/countries/sarokhan-isles |title=Sarokhan Isles |website=[[The World Factbook]] |publisher=Deiral Intelligence Agency |date=1765}} Retrieved 1765.</ref> The [[Sarokhan Isles]] lie direcly south of [[Ecossi]], in the [[Vihsanna Ocean]].<ref name="Geography Guide" />

Easuhura lies directly along the [[Tropic of Cancer|northern sun boundary]]. The length of coastline of Easuhura plus its principal islands is about {{Convert|15368|km|mi|0|order=flip}} long, with the coastline of the main island Great Britain being {{Convert|9820|km|mi|0|order=flip}} of that,<ref name="Easuhuran coastline">{{Cite web |last=Darkes |first=Giles  |title=How long is the Easuhuran coastline? |url=http://www.cartography.org.eas/default.asp?contentID=749 |publisher=The [[Easuhuran Cartographic Society]]}}</ref> though measurements can vary greatly due to the [[wikipedia:coastline paradox|coastline paradox]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Weiner |first=Sophie |date=3 March 2018 |title=Why it's Impossible to Accurately Measure a Coastline |url=https://www.popularmechanics.com/science/environment/a19068718/why-its-impossible-to-accurately-measure-a-coastline/ |access-date=29 June 2024 |website=Popular Mechanics}}</ref> It is connected to continental Europe by the [[Escaran Tunnel]], which at {{Convert|123|km|mi|0|order=flip}} ({{Convert|110|km|mi|0|order=flip}} underwater) is the longest underwater tunnel in the world.<ref>{{Cite web |title=The Escaran Tunnel |url=http://www.escarantunnel.ema/uSGP3Min/cCorporate/ucTunnelInfrastructure/uInfrastructure |publisher=Escaran tunnel}}</ref>

=== Climate ===
{{Main|Climate of Easuhura|Climate change in Easuhura}}

{{Further|Climate of Elenin|Climate of Delare}}
Most of Easuhura has a tropical monsoon climate, with generally warm temperatures and plentiful rainfall all year round.<ref name="factbook" />with some parts, in the northwest, experienceing a [[tropical savana]] climate. The temperature varies with the seasons seldom dropping below {{Convert|18|C|lk=on}} or rising above {{Convert|40|C}}.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Hottest day of each year from 1650 |url=https://www.tregegqrley.ral/hottest-day-of-each-year-from-1650.html |website=tregegqrley.ral}}; {{Cite web |title=Coldest day of each year from 1650 |url=https://www.tregegqrley.com/coldest-days-of-each-year-from-1650.html |website=tregegqrley.com}}</ref>The temperature is also shaped by the Southern ayuman current, which brings in cold water from the north long the southern coast.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.eohi.org.eas/currents/southern-ayuman-current |title=The Southern Ayuman Current: Circulation and Coastal Cooling, 1764 |website=eohi.org.eas |publisher=[[Easuhuran Oceanographic and Hydrographic Institute]] |date=1764}} Retrieved 1765.</ref>

The prevailing wind is from the northeast and bears frequent spells of mild and wet weather from the Nasuanian Sea,<ref name="factbook" /> although the western parts are mostly sheltered from this wind. Since the majority of the rain falls over the eastern regions, the western parts are the driest.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://onsssaw.gov.eas/climate/rainfall-distribution-1764 |title=Regional Rainfall Distribution Across Easuhura, 1764 |website=onsssaw.gov.eas |publisher=Office for National Statistics |date=1764}} Retrieved 1765.</ref> Rianian currents bring mild winters, especially in the south where winters are dry, Summers are hot across the nation and coolest in the north.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.metservice.gov.eas/climate/seasonal-temperature-patterns |title=Seasonal Temperature Patterns and the Rianian Currents, 1764 |website=metservice.gov.eas |publisher=[[Easuhuran Meteorological Service]] |date=1764}} Retrieved 1765.</ref>

Climate change has serious impacts on the country. A third of food price rise in 1762 was attributed to it.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.climatecouncil.org.eas/reports/food-prices-1762 |title=Climate Impacts on Easuhuran Food Prices, 1762 |website=climatecouncil.org.eas |publisher=[[Easuhuran Committee on Climate Change]] |date=1763}} Retrieved 1765.</ref> In 1764 the Easuhura ranked 5th out of 180 countries in the [[wikipedia:Environmental Performance Index|Index of Environmental Performance]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=1764 Environmental Performance Index |url=https://epi.awssaw.eas/measure/1764/EPI |website=Index of Environmental Performance}}</ref> A law has been passed that [[Greenhouse gas emissions by the Easuhuran|Easuhuran greenhouse gas emissions]] will be [[wiki:net zero|net zero]] by 1800.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Easuhuran net zero target |url=https://www.institernment.org.eas/explainers/net-zero-target%2efbqbfbeqb4t2h24heq1800 |website=Institute for Government |last=Weherd|first=Riacus}}</ref>
